meta.title: Raadi — buy and sell locally
meta.description: Raadi is an open-source marketplace for buying and selling in Norway: goods, cars, property, jobs and travel.

home.heroSubtitle: A safe, open marketplace for everything from second-hand furniture to your next home or job.

torget.name: Marketplace
torget.description: Furniture, electronics, clothes and everything in between.

bil.name: Cars
bil.description: Cars, motorcycles, boats and other vehicles.

eiendom.name: Property
eiendom.description: Homes for sale and for rent.

reise.name: Travel
reise.description: Holiday homes, trips and travel deals.

verified.title: Verified people
verified.body: Ratings and identity verification help you know who you are dealing with.

ai.title: Scam protection
ai.body: Listings and messages are screened for fraud, with humans reviewing uncertain cases.

privacy.title: Your data, your rights
privacy.body: GDPR by design: export or delete your data at any time.

account.title: My account
account.securityHint: Change your password, set up two-factor authentication or add a passkey.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: How Raadi processes personal data under the GDPR and the Norwegian Personal Data Act.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.body: The operator of this Raadi installation is the data controller for the personal data processed on the platform.

data.title: What we process
data.body: Account data (e-mail, name, language), listings and messages you create, and security logs. We only collect what is needed to run the marketplace.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We use one strictly necessary session cookie to keep you signed in. No tracking or advertising cookies are used, so no consent banner is needed.

ai.title: Automated decisions
ai.body: AI helps detect fraud and categorise listings. Personal data is redacted before it reaches a language model, every AI decision is logged, and uncertain decisions are reviewed by a human.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You may request access to, correction, export or deletion of your data, and object to processing. You can also complain to Datatilsynet.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Data is kept only as long as needed: expired listings and security logs are deleted automatically according to our retention policies.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Contact the operator of this installation for privacy questions.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist.

error.expired: Your login took too long or was already used. Please try again.
error.login_failed: We could not log you in. Please try again.
error.idp_error: The login service reported an error. Please try again later.
